info.title: bolo
info.description:
bolo serves speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice-activity detection.

* **openai** - drop-in `/v1/audio/*` and `/v1/models`
* **speaches** - model-management routes compatible with speaches
* **native** - `/api/v1/*`: catalog, pulls, cloud providers, stats, request traces, events, benchmark
* **voices** - `/api/v1/voices`: saved voices for the models that clone voices (consent required)
* WebSockets (not shown by OpenAPI): `/api/v1/stt/stream`, `/api/v1/tts/stream` - see docs/api.md

post.description:
Multipart form: ``file``, ``model``, optional ``language``, ``prompt``,
``response_format`` (json, text, srt, vtt, verbose_json), ``temperature``,
``timestamp_granularities[]`` (word, segment) and ``stream``.

Extensions: ``vad_filter`` (force or disable silence removal), ``vad_parameters`` (an object: ``threshold``,
``min_speech_duration_ms``, ``max_speech_duration_s``, ``min_silence_duration_ms``, ``speech_pad_ms``),
``chunk_length`` and ``hotwords``; Whisper decoding: ``condition_on_previous_text``, ``repetition_penalty``,
``no_repeat_ngram_size``, ``compression_ratio_threshold``, ``log_prob_threshold``, ``no_speech_threshold``,
``temperature_increment_on_fallback`` and ``hallucination_silence_threshold``; ``max_repeats`` (the repetition
guard: a phrase repeated back to back more often than this is cut to one copy; 0 turns it off). Options a model
cannot honour are listed in the ``x-bolo-ignored-options`` header. With diarization, ``separate_overlaps=true``
transcribes overlapped speech from one separated track per speaker.
``denoise`` runs a speech-enhancement model first: ``true``, ``false``, a strength between 0 and 1 (the
denoised audio mixed with the original) or a denoise model id; ``denoise_strength`` sets the strength
separately. Unset: the model's pin, then the server's ``denoise`` setting (off by default). The response
header ``x-bolo-denoise`` names what ran. Denoising can make clean audio worse.
Same form as transcriptions; needs a multilingual Whisper model.

Returns audio as it is synthesised (chunked transfer).

``response_format``: mp3 (default), opus, aac, flac, wav, pcm, plus the
telephony extensions ``mulaw`` and ``alaw`` (8 kHz G.711).
``stream_format``: ``audio`` (default) or ``sse`` (``speech.audio.delta`` events).

get.summary: List every model in the catalog
List voices of installed text-to-speech models

post.summary: Create a custom voice from an audio sample
post.description:
OpenAI's shape: ``audio_sample`` (file), ``name`` and ``consent``: the id of a consent recording
(``/v1/audio/voice_consents``), or bolo's statements ``self`` / ``permission``. Voices from a text prompt
(``type: prompt``) are not supported. The voice's id is made from its name; use it as ``voice`` (or
``{"id": ...}``) in ``/v1/audio/speech`` with a model that clones voices.

Multipart form: ``file`` and optional ``model``, ``threshold``, ``min_silence_duration_ms``,
``min_speech_duration_ms``, ``max_speech_duration_s``, ``speech_pad_ms``.
Returns ``[{"start": ms, "end": ms}, …]``.

Multipart form: ``file`` and optional ``model``. Returns the speaker embedding in the shape of OpenAI's
embeddings response: ``{"object": "list", "data": [{"object": "embedding", "embedding": [...], "index": 0}],
"model": ..., "usage": {"prompt_tokens": n, "total_tokens": n}}`` (``n``: samples at 16 kHz, as speaches counts).

The embedder is the speaker-embedding model of a diarization pipeline, the one that scores cloned voices
(setting ``voice_similarity_model``, else ``default_diarization``). A ``model`` that is not in bolo's catalog
(speaches' ``pyannote/wespeaker-voxceleb-resnet34-LM``, for one) uses that default. The vector is unit length;
the cosine of two of them is the speaker similarity. Clips longer than 30 s use their first 30 s.

get.summary: Model catalog with install and load state
This machine: CPU, memory, disk, GPUs, runtimes, container limits
get.description:
What bolo detected, best effort: a value it could not read is ``null`` (unknown). Detected once and kept;
``refresh=true`` looks again and also runs the slower probes (the torch plugin's device, server binaries'
versions, ``llama-server --list-devices``, nvidia-smi), whose answers are reused for 60 s and forgotten when a
component is installed; ``refresh=force`` runs them again at once. ``speed`` says how fast this machine is
against the one the catalog was measured on, and whether that was measured (the micro-benchmark) or estimated.
Nothing here restricts what can be pulled or loaded.

post.summary: Run the micro-benchmark (a few seconds of CPU)
post.description:
Times a tiny fixed workload, stores the result in the data directory and scales the catalog's measured
real-time factors with it from then on (``bolo recommend --benchmark`` does the same).

get.summary: Catalog models for a task, ranked for this machine
get.description:
Every model of the task that passes the filters asked for, best fit first. Hardware never removes a
model from the list: the ones that are unlikely to fit sort last, each with the reason. ``realtime=true``
ranks for live speech, ``realtime=false`` for batch work (files, voice-over). Without ``task``: an overview
of every task, each with its default, its recommendations and its first ``limit`` results (3 by default).

get.summary: A set of models for one use and language
get.description:
``use`` is ``live`` (conversation: STT and TTS that keep up with speech, plus VAD and end of turn),
``files`` (transcription: STT, plus diarization) or ``voiceover`` (TTS). The answer names one model per
task with alternatives, and lists what would have to be pulled. Local models unless ``local_only=false``.

put.summary: Pin settings for one model (phonemiser, text normaliser, word lists)
Add or change a cloud provider
put.description:
Stored in ``<data_dir>/providers.json`` (mode 0600). Providers from the configuration file or the
environment cannot be changed here. Refused on a non-loopback bind without an API key.

post.summary: Check that a provider answers and accepts the key
post.description:
One cheap request to the provider (a model, voice or project listing; nothing billed). The answer says
whether the key itself was checked (``checked: credentials``) or only the address (``reachability``).

Optional JSON body ``{"keep_alive": "10m"}`` (or ``?keep_alive=``). The answer says where the model went:
``processor`` ("100% GPU", "35%/65% CPU/GPU", ...), ``placement`` and, when it is not all on the accelerator
that was asked for, a ``notice``.
Unloads now (``bolo stop``). A request still using the model finishes first.

get.summary: Loaded models: size, GPU/CPU split, keep-alive (Ollama style)
get.description:
Like Ollama's ``/api/ps``: per model ``size``, ``size_vram`` (bytes), ``processor`` ("100% GPU", "100% CPU",
"35%/65% CPU/GPU"), ``device``, ``expires_at`` (null: kept loaded), ``until``; plus the machine (CPU, RAM, each
GPU's used and total memory) and the budgets.

post.summary: Copy a model's settings to a new name (a preset)
post.description:
Like Ollama's ``/api/copy``: ``destination`` becomes a preset of ``source``, a catalog entry that uses the same
files and starts with the same settings (catalog options and pinned settings), which can then be changed with
``PUT /api/v1/models/{destination}/settings`` without touching ``source``. Nothing is downloaded or copied on
disk; deleting the preset leaves the files alone.

get.description:
The catalog entry plus its files and sizes, the settings that apply (``effective``: device, keep-alive,
num_parallel, max_queue and, for llama.cpp voices, the llama-server tuning), the presets made from it and its
speed (the catalog's measurements, this server's, and the expected real-time factor here). ``?license=true``
adds the text of a licence file shipped with the model (``license_text``).

post.description:
Multipart form: ``file`` and optional ``model``, ``num_speakers``, ``min_speakers``,
``max_speakers``, ``threshold`` (clustering distance; lower finds more speakers).

``separate_overlaps=true`` also separates overlapped stretches into one track per speaker
(``separation_model``, ``separation_context_s``, ``separation_min_overlap_s``,
``separation_allow_narrowband``; ``separation_audio=true`` returns the tracks as WAV data URLs).

get.summary: Optional components (uccharan, espeak-ng, TTS servers, engine plugins)

post.description:
Installs the component and activates it without a restart. eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0-or-later) requires
``{"accept_license": true}``. ``llama-server`` and ``audio.cpp`` download a pinned upstream release (SHA-256
checked) into the data directory.

get.summary: Server-Sent Events: stats, request, request_progress, job, model, log
One word list (JSON entries, TSV or PLS)

put.summary: Create or replace a word list (TSV, PLS or JSON body)

post.description:
Render ``text`` with this word list (``-`` for none beyond the pinned and default lists)
for each model: the capability record, the text or phonemes the voice would receive, and the
entries applied.

get.summary: How a model's voices take text

post.description:
Fields: ``file`` (one or more recordings of the same person; ``files[]`` also works), ``name``,
``consent`` (required: ``self`` = "this is my voice", ``permission`` = "I have the speaker's permission"),
optional ``id``, ``transcript`` (else transcribed by the default STT model when installed; ``transcribe=false``
skips that), ``language``, ``description``, ``default_model``, ``created_by`` (a name to record) and
``score_model`` (speak a test sentence with that model and return the speaker similarity; default: the
voice's ``default_model``). The reference is cleaned (silence trimmed, loudness normalised, 24 kHz, 2 to
60 s) and checked; ``warnings`` says when it is short, noisy, clipped or sounds like several people.

post.summary: Import saved voices from a .zip export
post.description:
``file``: an export; ``consent`` (for voices whose metadata has no consent record); ``replace=true``
overwrites voices of the same id (they are skipped otherwise).

post.summary: Save a blend of a model's voices
post.description:
Saves ``blend`` (voices of ``model`` joined by '+', each optionally weighted: ``af_bella(0.7)+af_sky(0.3)``;
weights are normalised) under ``name``. Use it as ``voice`` in ``/v1/audio/speech``; without ``model`` there,
the blend's model answers. A blend imitates no one: no recording and no consent statement are needed. The
entry is marked ``"kind": "blend"`` and listed under ``blends``.

get.summary: Speaker similarity of a model's clone
get.description:
Speaks a test sentence (``text``, else one in the voice's language) in this voice with ``model`` (default:
the voice's default model, else the default TTS model) and compares the speaker of the result with the
reference: cosine similarity of speaker embeddings (``similarity``), the ``verdict`` from the calibrated
thresholds, and the synthesis speed. ``audio=true`` also returns the clip as a data URL. The score is kept in
the voice's ``scores``.

post.description:
OpenAI's consent recording: ``recording`` (the speaker reading a consent statement), ``name`` and
``language`` (BCP 47). Its id is then the ``consent`` of ``POST /v1/audio/voices``. bolo stores the
recording with the voice library; it does not check what is said in it.

get.description:
Always 200 while the server runs (a restart cannot bring a lost GPU back). ``status`` is "degraded" with
a ``gpu`` object while the GPU is lost (bolo.gpu_health).

post.summary: Chat completions with audio in and out (speech front end to your LLM)
post.description:
Needs ``llm_base_url``. Audio parts are transcribed, the text request goes to the configured
model, and the reply is synthesised when ``modalities`` contains ``"audio"``. Requests without
audio are proxied unchanged. Extensions (not forwarded): ``transcription_model``,
``transcription_language``, ``speech_model``.

post.summary: Create an ephemeral key for Realtime sessions
post.description:
Body (all optional): ``{"expires_after": {"anchor": "created_at", "seconds": 600}, "session": {...}}``.

Needs the server API key. The returned ``value`` (``ek_...``) can be handed to a browser: it opens
Realtime sessions (WebSocket or WebRTC) until it expires and is not accepted by any other route.

post.summary: Start a Realtime session over WebRTC (SDP offer/answer)
post.description:
Send the SDP offer as the body (``Content-Type: application/sdp``), or as the ``sdp`` field of a
multipart form together with an optional ``session`` field holding the session configuration as JSON.
The answer is ``201`` with the SDP answer as the body and the call in the ``Location`` header.

Authentication: the server API key or an ephemeral client secret. Query: ``model``,
``intent=transcription``. Needs the ``webrtc`` extra (aiortc).

get.summary: Telephony: providers, webhook URLs, agents, numbers (no secrets)
Voice agents that answer and place calls

put.summary: Add or change a voice agent
put.description:
Stored in ``<data_dir>/telephony.json``. Agents from the configuration file cannot be changed here.
Refused on a non-loopback bind without an API key.

put.summary: Map a called number to an agent

post.summary: Place an outbound call and attach an agent
post.description:
Body: ``{"provider": "twilio", "to": "+14155550100", "agent": "front-desk", "from": "+1...",
"metadata": {}}``. ``from`` defaults to the provider's ``from_number``. The answer is the call record;
poll ``GET /api/v1/telephony/calls/{id}`` for what happened.

Outbound calling is regulated (consent, calling hours, do-not-call registers such as TRAI's DND in India,
disclosure that a machine is speaking). Compliance is the operator's responsibility.

get.summary: One call: timeline, turns with latency, transcript

post.summary: Simulate a call to an agent through a fake provider
post.description:
Body: ``{"agent": "front-desk", "provider": "twilio", "scenario": "basic" | {...}, "noise_db": 20}``.
A scripted caller speaks to the agent through a fake provider connection inside this process (no network,
no telephony account) with the models this server is configured with. The answer is the simulator's report:
what the caller heard, latency as the caller experiences it, and whether the expectations were met. The
call also appears among the recent calls.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `batch` (back-to-back requests) or `realtime` (1x paced streams); STT only.

name.title: Name
name.description: The blend's name; its id is made from it unless `id` is given.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Voices of the model joined by '+', with optional weights: af_bella(0.7)+af_sky(0.3).

model.title: Model
model.description: A model that blends voices (Kokoro); default: the default TTS model.

source.title: Source
source.description: The model to copy (an id or alias).

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: The new name: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

phonemizer.title: Phonemizer
phonemizer.description: Pin the phonemiser of a voice: auto, uccharan, uccharan:improved or espeak-ng; null removes the pin.

text_normalizer.title: Text Normalizer
text_normalizer.description: Pin the text normaliser of a voice that reads text: uccharan (default), light (bolo's own), model (the model's own) or none; null removes the pin.

wordlists.title: Wordlists
wordlists.description: Pin pronunciation word lists to the model, highest priority first; null removes the pin.

romanised.title: Romanised
romanised.description: Pin how the model's voices take romanised text (an Indian language typed in Latin letters): off, auto (convert to the voice's script when the text is mostly Latin) or on; null removes the pin (the server's `romanised` setting applies).

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Models (of the same task, local or cloud) that answer instead when this one is unavailable, overloaded or its provider fails, in order; null removes the pin, [] switches a configured fallback off.

device.title: Device
device.description: Pin where the model runs: cpu, cuda, cuda:1, coreml, auto, ... (overrides the `device` setting for this model; it still goes on the CPU when it does not fit on the accelerator); null removes the pin.

keep_alive.title: Keep Alive
keep_alive.description: Pin how long the model stays loaded when idle: seconds or a duration ('10m'); -1 keeps it loaded; 0 unloads it after each request; null removes the pin.

num_parallel.title: Num Parallel
num_parallel.description: Requests the model works on at once (Ollama's num_parallel; a llama-server bolo starts gets --parallel). Applies from the next load; null removes the pin.

max_queue.title: Max Queue
max_queue.description: Requests that may wait for the model before it answers 429. Applies from the next load; null removes the pin.

flash_attention.title: Flash Attention
flash_attention.description: llama.cpp models: flash attention (-fa) of the llama-server bolo starts. Applies from the next load; null removes the pin.

kv_cache_type.title: Kv Cache Type
kv_cache_type.description: llama.cpp models: K and V cache type (f16, q8_0, q4_0, ...), like OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE. Applies from the next load; null removes the pin.

context_size.title: Context Size
context_size.description: llama.cpp models: context size (-c); 0: llama-server's default.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: llama.cpp models: batch size (-b); 0: llama-server's default.

condition_on_previous_text.title: Condition On Previous Text
condition_on_previous_text.description: Whisper models: give the decoder the text of the previous window as its prompt (faster-whisper and whisper.cpp; bolo's default is false, which avoids most repetition loops).

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: faster-whisper: penalty on tokens already generated (> 0; 1 is off, 1.1 to 1.3 is a usual value against loops).

no_repeat_ngram_size.title: No Repeat Ngram Size
no_repeat_ngram_size.description: faster-whisper: never repeat an n-gram of this many tokens (0 to 100; 0 is off).

compression_ratio_threshold.title: Compression Ratio Threshold
compression_ratio_threshold.description: faster-whisper: a window whose text compresses better than this (gzip ratio; default 2.4) is decoded again at a higher temperature; needs temperature_increment_on_fallback.

log_prob_threshold.title: Log Prob Threshold
log_prob_threshold.description: Whisper models: average log probability below which a window counts as failed (-100 to 0; default -1).

no_speech_threshold.title: No Speech Threshold
no_speech_threshold.description: Whisper models: a window more likely silence than this (0 to 1; default 0.6) with a low log probability is dropped.

temperature_increment_on_fallback.title: Temperature Increment On Fallback
temperature_increment_on_fallback.description: Whisper models: retry a failed window at this much higher temperature, up to 1 (0 to 1; bolo's faster-whisper default is 0, no retries; whisper.cpp's own default is 0.2).

hallucination_silence_threshold.title: Hallucination Silence Threshold
hallucination_silence_threshold.description: faster-whisper: skip silent stretches longer than this many seconds when a hallucination is suspected (computes word timings).

chunk_length.title: Chunk Length
chunk_length.description: Longest piece of audio decoded at once, in seconds (1 to 30; default 30).

vad_filter.title: Vad Filter
vad_filter.description: Remove silence before decoding: true always, false never; unset: only for audio longer than the model's window.

vad_parameters.title: Vad Parameters
vad_parameters.description: Silence removal tuning: threshold, min_speech_duration_ms, max_speech_duration_s, min_silence_duration_ms, speech_pad_ms.

max_repeats.title: Max Repeats
max_repeats.description: Repetition guard: a phrase (1 to 8 words) repeated back to back more often than this is cut to one copy, and so is a run of identical segments (default 4; 0 turns it off).

denoise.title: Denoise
denoise.description: Speech-to-text models: denoise audio before this model hears it unless the request says otherwise: true, false, a strength between 0 and 1 or a denoise model id; null removes the pin.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the text (default: each model's).

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Voice id, for models whose voices differ.

romanised.title: Romanised
romanised.description: off, auto or on (default: each model's setting). The preview never refuses: when the conversion cannot happen the item's `romanised.notice` says why.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: openai-compatible, sarvam, elevenlabs, deepgram or soniox.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: Write-only. Absent or empty keeps the stored key; it is never returned by any route.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: Price table for cost estimates: {<provider model or *>: {per_minute, per_hour, per_1k_chars, per_1m_chars, per_request, currency}}.

id.title: Id
id.description: Catalog id or alias, `hf:<repo>` for any compatible Hugging Face model, `piper:<voice>` (for example `piper:te_IN-venkatesh-medium`) for any voice of the Piper project, or `uccharan-<pack>` (for example `uccharan-de`) for one of uccharan's language packs.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Only for `hf:` pulls: loader kind when it cannot be detected.

accept_license.title: Accept License
accept_license.description: Only for uccharan's CC BY-SA 4.0 packs (`uccharan-xlit-*`, `uccharan-wikipron-*`): accept the licence.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A voice of the model, or a saved voice (/api/v1/voices) for a model that clones voices: by id (`"priya"`) or as OpenAI's custom-voice object (`{"id": "priya"}`, which prefers the saved voice). For a model that blends voices (Kokoro), a blend of its voices: `"af_bella+af_sky"` or `"af_bella(0.7)+af_sky(0.3)"` (weights normalised), or a saved blend's id.

language.title: Language
language.description: Extension: language hint for text normalisation.

detect_language.title: Detect Language
detect_language.description: Extension: without `language`, guess the language of a multilingual model from the text and, unless a voice of the model is named, choose a voice that speaks it (`x-bolo-language` says what was decided). An explicit voice or language is never changed.

keep_alive.title: Keep Alive
keep_alive.description: Extension (Ollama's keep_alive): how long the voice stays loaded after this request: seconds or a duration ('10m'); 0 unloads it when the request ends; -1 keeps it loaded.

normalize.title: Normalize
normalize.description: Extension: text normalisation. true: the voice's default (uccharan's normalise-only mode for voices that read text, when installed); `uccharan`, `light` (bolo's own), `model` (leave it to the model) or false/`none`.

input_format.title: Input Format
input_format.description:
Extension: `ssml` accepts , , , , , ,

, . In every format, Kokoro-style [word](/ipa/) sets a word's pronunciation.

wordlists.title: Wordlists
wordlists.description: Extension: pronunciation word lists to apply, highest priority first (names from /api/v1/wordlists). Default: the lists pinned to the model, then `default`; [] applies none.

pronunciations.title: Pronunciations
pronunciations.description: Extension: inline word-list entries [{word, ipa?, say?, lang?, match?}], applied before any list.

romanised.title: Romanised
romanised.description: Extension: write an Indian language typed in Latin letters ("mujhe kal office jana hai") in the voice's script before it is read. `auto`: when the voice speaks an Indian language and the text is mostly Latin script; `on` (or true): always for such a voice, 424 `component_missing` when uccharan's transliterator or the language's pack is not installed; `off` (or false). Default: the model's pinned setting, else the server's `romanised` setting.

phonemizer.title: Phonemizer
phonemizer.description: Extension: who turns text into phonemes for voices that read phonemes: auto, uccharan (= uccharan:compatible), uccharan:improved or espeak-ng. Default: the voice's pinned choice, else the server's `phonemizer` setting.

reference_audio.title: Reference Audio
reference_audio.description: Extension: a recording of the voice to imitate, base64 or a data URL (WAV, FLAC, MP3, …), for models that clone voices (`features` has `voice-cloning`). Up to 30 s are used.

reference_text.title: Reference Text
reference_text.description: Extension: the transcript of `reference_audio` (some cloning models use it).

options.title: Options
options.description: Extension: model-specific request options, for example Tontaube's `style` (audiobook, conversational, agentic) and sliders (`rate`, `pause`, `pitch_range`, `pitch_level`, `legato`). A model answers 400 for an option it does not read.

default_model.title: Default Model
default_model.description: A model that clones voices (for a blend: one that blends voices); empty string clears it.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Saved blends only: new voices and weights.
